Read and follow [../DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](../DESIGN_SYSTEM.md) and [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing this IELTS Learning repository. All HTML pages must import assets/css/site.css and assets/js/site.js; no page-local CSS, inline styles or event handlers. Update navigation, keep Task 1 reviews and 5-color pastel highlighting consistent. Run `node scripts/check-design.mjs` before commit. HTML page navigation is the only catalog source of truth. README.md should retain only a stable link to the GitHub Pages homepage; do not append per-essay links or sync Markdown directories. Keep existing Markdown study notes unless explicitly told to edit them.
